schema_note: Enriched U013 card: merges the original unification candidate, the audit, the 4-skeptic panel, and the Test-Hardener+Fertility-Judge repair+scores produced 2026-06-03. Repair narrows the claim from a four-domain unification to a two-deterministic-leg shared-proof reorganization (D2 no-false-arrows + D4 lumpability) with the QM no-signalling leg explicitly split off as imported recovery. All load-bearing corpus claims were re-verified in-repo on 2026-06-03 (see source_reverification_2026_06_03).

original_card.one_sentence_claim: A single coarsening-monotonicity contract -- the audit functional A satisfies A(Q_f mu, Q_f mu') <= A(mu, mu') under every admissible pushforward Q_f -- is the one consistency condition behind three normally-separate physics nulls: no-false-arrows (a coarse-grained irreversibility arrow cannot exceed the micro arrow), the lumpability/closure-deficit null (exactly lumpable coarse-graining carries zero closure obstruction, CD_tau=0 iff tau-closed), and operational no-signalling (a remote basis choice leaves a local unconditional marginal invariant); read on three declared lenses, each null is the same monotone-divergence inequality saturating at its hypothesis surface, with the deterministic classical legs proved (Lean-anchored for the TV face) and the quantum no-signalling leg honestly imported.
domains_unified: D2 (nonequilibrium statistical mechanics / stochastic thermodynamics: no-false-arrows)
D3 (information theory: monotone-divergence / DPI backbone, CMI chain rule)
D4 (renormalization / coarse-graining: lumpability and closure deficit)
QM (quantum measurement / quantum information: no-signalling marginal-invariance face)
original_card.shared_mechanism: audit-DPI: the coarsening-monotone audit functional A -- instantiated as path-space KL asymmetry Sigma_T, total variation, quantum relative entropy, or conditional mutual information -- is non-increasing under any admissible coarse-graining pushforward Q_f (or partial trace / CPTP map). Each physics null is this one inequality read on a declared lens and saturated at its hypothesis surface.
original_card.minimum_viable_unification: A short note proving: GIVEN the audit-monotonicity contract A(Q_f mu, Q_f mu') <= A(mu, mu'), the three nulls are corollaries on three declared lenses -- (i) NG_ARROW_DPI / thm:dpi_path delivers no-false-arrows; (ii) the CMI identity with CD_tau=0 iff tau-closed delivers the lumpability / closure-deficit null (Kemeny-Snell recovered); (iii) no-signalling marginal invariance, with the finite deterministic TV-DPI as the classical analogue while the genuine quantum guard is the IMPORTED CPTP-DPI.
original_card.honest_status_note: PARTIALLY beats the deflation critique. The underlying object IS textbook f-divergence monotonicity (DPI); SBT adds ZERO new quantitative content. The 'one law' is carried by NAMING: the commutative-subalgebra corollary that would make the classical and quantum legs literally the same theorem is UNWRITTEN. The QM no-signalling leg imports partial-trace/CPTP marginal invariance, CPTP-DPI, and Born statistics by citation; SBT does no work on the only step with physical content, so that leg is class-A recovery and opposite-world ELASTIC. Only the deterministic-partition TV audit is claimed Lean-certified; KL/Sigma_T audits and stochastic kernels are acknowledged-missing. What genuinely survives: for the two DETERMINISTIC legs (D2 no-false-arrows, D4 lumpability) the unification is a deductive, opposite-world-INELASTIC theorem, and the SAME inequality demonstrably spans three normally-disconnected domains.

(1) State the audit-monotonicity contract once on a finite probability space with A a monotone f-divergence and Q_f a deterministic surjective pushforward. (2) D2 leg: instantiate A=Sigma_T (path-space KL asymmetry); by reversal-commutation + KL contraction under the pointwise path extension f^{(T+1)} obtain NG_ARROW_DPI (no-false-arrows), with EPR=0 at the detailed-balance saturation surface. Both legs are deductive theorems already written in the corpus, hence opposite-world INELASTIC (SBT cannot produce macro-arrow>micro-arrow or a fabricated closure obstruction). (4) Demarcation appendix: exhibit the finite TV-DPI (thm:tv-dpi) as the same-shaped classical analogue of operational no-signalling, and EXPLICITLY flag that the quantum content (CPTP-DPI, partial-trace marginal invariance, Born statistics) is IMPORTED by citation and opposite-world ELASTIC -- not unified. (5) Carry the Sigma_T-is-an-informational-proxy disclaimer and the lens-is-a-free-input disclaimer on every cross-domain statement. The honest selling point: ONE proved finite monotone-divergence theorem controls both irreversibility-arrow bounds and effective-theory closure obstructions -- two results normally taught in two disconnected courses -- inelastically.
